parent.text: 售票员把窗口里的灯关掉时，雨正沿着站台的屋檐连成一条线。站台上的钟比手机慢了三分钟。林远核对了两次，没有走去询问值班员。他看见玻璃上自己的倒影，才发现他已经穿着这件外套站了很久。行李箱旁挂着新公司的地址，手机里存着一份还没签字的合同；这些东西都能说明他要去哪里，却没有一样能替他解释为什么迟迟不肯往前走。

scope: Actual UI skip-all unlocks one route (not full natural/manual reading); real manual save/read, eight rapid replay exits with native renderer diagnostics and explicit retry when needed, default project reveal with no reduced-motion override. No injected session/unlocks/native media events; desktop engines and phone viewport are not physical phones or OS/rights/HTTPS acceptance.
